title: Customers Who Never Order
description:
Write an SQL query to report all customers who never order anything.

Table `Customers`: `id (INT), name (TEXT)`
Table `Orders`: `id (INT), customerId (INT)`
output_format: Names of customers with no orders.
constraints: customerId in Orders matches id in Customers.

sample_tests.explanation: Henry and Max have placed 0 orders.

hints: Use `WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customerId FROM Orders)`.
Alternatively, use a `LEFT JOIN` and check `WHERE Orders.id IS NULL`.
Returns all customer names with no corresponding order.
